seoTitle: Data Viz Palette Builder: Color-Blind-Safe Chart Colors
metaDescription: Build categorical, sequential or diverging chart palettes and check distances under protanopia, deuteranopia and tritanopia. Free, local.
intro: Generates a chart palette of the type and size you choose and reports the closest colour pair under normal vision and three colour vision deficiencies.
why:
Chart colours must stay apart for everyone. Categorical palettes are chosen from a candidate set by picking, one at a time, the colour farthest from those already chosen, across all four views. Sequential palettes step lightness at a fixed hue. Diverging palettes use two hues meeting at a light middle.

Distances are OKLab differences times 100, using the Machado 2009 simulation at full severity. The review threshold of 8 is a rule of thumb. Add labels or patterns for important series.
howTo: Choose Categorical, Sequential or Diverging and the number of colours.
Set hues for sequential and diverging palettes.
Run and read the distance check.
Copy the JavaScript array or CSS variables.
